textbooks.title: Fluid Mechanics: Fundamentals and Applications
textbooks.authors: Yunus A. Çengel & John M. Cimbala
textbooks.bestFor: Clearest physical intuition for fluid properties, hydrostatics, manometry, Bernoulli's equation, and pipe head losses.

textbooks.title: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics
textbooks.authors: Bruce R. Munson, Donald F. Young & Theodore H. Okiishi
textbooks.bestFor: Rigorous submerged surface force derivations, control-volume momentum problems, and Buckingham Pi dimensional analysis.

textbooks.title: A Textbook of Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulic Machines
textbooks.bestFor: High volume of step-by-step SI-unit exam calculations very close to Nigerian engineering test style.

textbooks.title: Vector Mechanics for Engineers: Statics and Dynamics
textbooks.authors: F. P. Beer, E. R. Johnston, D. F. Mazurek & P. J. Cornwell
textbooks.bestFor: Complete OAU Applied Mechanics bible — covers both Statics (forces, equilibrium, friction, centroids) and Dynamics (kinematics, energy, momentum) in one text.

textbooks.title: Engineering Mechanics: Statics & Dynamics
textbooks.bestFor: Crispest Free-Body Diagrams and structured 'Procedure for Analysis' boxes — best companion when Beer & Johnston feels dense.
chapters: Ch. 3–5: Equilibrium of Particles & Rigid Bodies

textbooks.title: Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics
textbooks.authors: J. L. Meriam & L. G. Kraige
textbooks.bestFor: Sharp plane kinematics and rigid-body motion problems with concise, no-fluff engineering derivations.
chapters: Ch. 5: Plane Kinematics of Rigid Bodies

textbooks.title: Calculus: Early Transcendentals
textbooks.bestFor: Gold standard for limits, continuity, differentiation, partial & total derivatives, directional derivatives, and first-order ODEs.

textbooks.title: Schaum's Outline of Linear Algebra
textbooks.bestFor: Fast, no-nonsense drill book for matrices, determinants, inverses, and systems of linear equations (super light PDF).

textbooks.title: Schaum's Outline of Vector Analysis
textbooks.bestFor: Classic OAU favorite for vector algebra, dot/cross products, gradient, divergence, curl, and directional derivatives.
chapters: Ch. 1–2: Vector Algebra, Dot & Cross Products

drills.title: Hydrostatic Force on a Vertical Rectangular Sluice Gate
drills.preview: A vertical 2.0 m × 3.0 m gate holds fresh water up to its top edge. Find the resultant hydrostatic force FR in kN.

drills.title: Mercury U-Tube Manometer Pipe Gauge Pressure
drills.preview: Water pipe connected to a mercury (SG = 13.6) U-tube manometer with h₁ = 0.25 m and h₂ = 0.40 m. Find gauge pressure PA.

drills.title: Symmetric Two-Cable Suspension Equilibrium
drills.preview: A 150 N workshop fixture hangs from two symmetric cables inclined at 30° above the horizontal. Compute each cable tension.

drills.title: 2D Vector Cross-Product Moment About a Pivot
drills.preview: Force F = (40i + 30j) N acts at r = (0.5i + 0.2j) m from pivot O. Compute the scalar moment Mz = (r × F)z.

drills.title: Overhanging Beam Support Reaction Analysis
drills.preview: A 5.0 m beam pinned at A with a roller at C (4.0 m from A) carries 200 N at the free overhang end B. Find reaction RC.

drills.title: Conjugate Rationalization Limit Evaluation
drills.preview: Evaluate lim(x → 4) (√x − 2) / (x − 4) by multiplying numerator and denominator by the radical conjugate.

drills.title: 2×2 Matrix Determinant Computation
drills.preview: Evaluate det(A) for the 2×2 matrix [[7, 4], [3, 5]] using ad − bc.

drills.title: 3D Vector Dot Product Evaluation
drills.preview: Given u = 3i − 2j + 4k and v = 2i + 5j − k, compute the scalar dot product u · v.
